sources.title: Detection of gravitational-wave bursts with chirplet-like template families
sources.mechanism: Gaussian-windowed sinusoids and chirps motivate finite time-frequency ridges.
sources.implementation: Approximate Gaussian energy ridges, not the paper chirplet search or waveform bank.

sources.title: Reducing Scattered Light in LIGO's Third Observing Run
sources.mechanism: Scattered light associated with moving surfaces gives arches; instantaneous frequency scales with surface speed.
sources.implementation: Sinusoidal absolute-frequency arches; no real auxiliary channels or empirical physical parameters fitted.

sources.title: ArchGEM: an Advanced Data Analysis Tool for Analyzing Scattered Light Noise in LIGO
sources.mechanism: Phase-derived Doppler frequency and arch geometry; f_peak=2*A*omega/lambda.
sources.implementation: Motivates arch parameterization only. No GMM, paper code, labels, or pretrained model used.

sources.title: Gravity Spy: lessons learned and a path forward
sources.mechanism: Four temporal windows expose different glitch timescales.
sources.implementation: Four-window input is a separate root-owned ablation. This generator training keeps the original one-second full plus low-frequency crop.

mathematical_model: P(t,f)=sum_j A_j e_j(t) exp(-(log(f)-log(f_j(t)))^2/(2*sigma_j^2)); localized bursts use a2D Gaussian. Chirps use f0*(1+k*u+q*u^2), arches fpeak*abs(cos(pi*(t-t0)/period+phase)); colored positive image-space noise has a power-law FFT envelope. Foreground RMS is equalized then shared gain/log1p compression applied.
limits: Not a physical detector or exact Q-transform simulator; correlated noise is an image-space approximation.
Prior development failures motivated the domain-specific families and no claim of untouched domain choice is made.
The papers motivate mechanisms; the parameter distributions and implementation are engineering choices, not published performance guarantees.
